issues: The README states requirements we cannot meet: 'TensorFlow 1.10.0 or newer with GPU support', 'One or more high-end NVIDIA GPUs with at least 11GB of DRAM', and a CUDA toolkit and cuDNN (README.md:76-78).

GPU-only code path: the network code uses data_format='NCHW' for conv2d, depthwise_conv2d and avg_pool (training/networks_stylegan.py:47,90,168), which TensorFlow's CPU kernels do not support, and dnnlib/tflib/network.py:408 pins ops to /gpu:N. The recorded pass needed a new NCHW->NHWC shim injected into the pickled network source, plus allow_soft_placement (repo_diff: network.py and tfutil.py, and a new cpu_compat.py). By the exam-time rule this repo should have been excluded.

If it stays tested, the goal leaks the workaround: 'CPU workarounds (e.g. NCHW convolutions)' names the exact fix. A separate real problem: dnnlib.util.open_url saves Google Drive's virus-scan HTML page instead of the 300 MB pickle (probe NOTES item 3), so pretrained_example.py fails to download the model as written, even on a GPU machine.
evidence: src/nvlabs-stylegan/README.md:76-78 - TF with GPU support, NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA/cuDNN
data/runs/nvlabs-stylegan/deliverables/NOTES.md items 3-5 - Google Drive HTML instead of the pickle; GPU-pinned ops; NCHW shim
